rationale.text: The page declares the HTML 4.01 Transitional doctype and holds a u element. The methodology and the glossary forbid u when the doctype does not correspond to HTML 5, and HTML 4.01 is not HTML 5, so the exception does not apply. The custom check faults u under an earlier doctype (step 1), so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Vérifier l’absence de l’élément `<u>` uniquement si le DOCTYPE du document ne correspond pas à HTML 5 ;
L’élément <u> est interdit uniquement si le DOCTYPE du document ne correspond pas à HTML 5.
